events.observation: After the owner revoke and three observation cycles, both provider workers logged EOF. The test sent Escape. Browser exited normally; Notes was cancelled after the 20-second shutdown bound, outcome killed, code -9. The supervisor exited 1; the sampled resource count was restored. The trigger and exact blocking location are not established, and this is not proof of the cause of the earlier single-source Consumer timeout.

events.observation: The initial Notes snapshot returned capped=true and queryDurationNs=50000000. The provider has a 30 ms traversal condition among several reasons for capping, but the response does not identify which condition fired. The watch emitted SOURCE_UNKNOWN with INVALID_SNAPSHOT, recovered on the next cycle with RESET_REQUIRED, and did not misreport the source as unchanged. The verifier correctly rejected the session as a complete baseline. Both providers and supervisor exited normally and sampled resources were restored.
